hero.name: Asha Dange

about.summary: With over a decade of multifaceted experience spanning higher education and the corporate software testing sector, I specialize in bridging the gap between academic curriculum and industry expectations. As the Head of the Computer Department and IQAC Coordinator, I am deeply committed to institutional quality enhancement, fostering student success, and driving strategic academic initiatives.

responsibilities: Overseeing departmental academic operations and curriculum planning.
Managing faculty allocations and departmental resources.
Driving initiatives for student skill enhancement and industry readiness.
experience.achievements: Successfully implemented modern teaching pedagogies and increased student placement rates.

responsibilities: Coordinating NAAC accreditation processes and documentation.
Organizing extension activities and community service programs.
Implementing quality benchmarks for academic and administrative activities.
experience.achievements: Spearheaded successful quality audits and organized multiple community outreach programs.

responsibilities: Designed and executed comprehensive manual and automated test cases.
Performed API and Database testing to ensure data integrity and security.
Collaborated with development teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies.
experience.achievements: Reduced defect leakage by 30% through robust automation suites.

responsibilities: Delivered lectures on core Computer Science subjects (Java, DB, Web Tech).
Mentored students for academic projects and technical presentations.
Evaluated student performance and provided constructive feedback.
experience.achievements: Achieved 100% pass rate in taught subjects for three consecutive semesters.
